grounding_gaps.reason: The reference system is PyLabRobot 0.2.1 LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend. No physical robot, VENUS run, calibration, collision, timing, or Hamilton liquid-class behavior is claimed.
PyLabRobot is a Python SDK. The HTTPS paths are an internal Datalox transport projection; evaluated code keeps the native LiquidHandler call surface.
All runtime state changes are isolated local shadows. The provider runtime contains no Hamilton or PyLabRobot upstream client.

sources.derivation: Pinned PyLabRobot 0.2.1 source and stable documentation define the backend-agnostic LiquidHandler contract, Chatterbox dry-run backend, standard channel operations, resource trackers, and native exceptions.

A fresh PyLabRobot 0.2.1 environment executed setup, stop, pickup, return/drop, aspirate, dispense, duplicate pickup, no-tip aspiration, source underflow, tip underflow, container overflow, occupied-tip-spot drop, duplicate setup, and duplicate stop against LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend.
Local tests execute native PyLabRobot calls through the Datalox backend, provider-runtime transitions, atomic failures, task-free compilation, reset, and explicit hardware-scope denials.
